Bare URLs that must become links. TestBareURLs reads every file in this
folder. A case starts at a "~~ case: <name>" line; the note's markdown runs
to "~~ want", and the HTML it must render runs to the next case. Anything
before the first case is this header. Each case renders alone, so its
first paragraph is p1.

~~ case: in a sentence
see https://x.org now
~~ want
<p id="p1">see <a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a> now</p>
~~ case: http, an address and a port
http://143.244.172.148:9210/tutorial/
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="http://143.244.172.148:9210/tutorial/">http://143.244.172.148:9210/tutorial/</a></p>
~~ case: a path, a query and a fragment
https://x.org/a/b.html?c=1&d=2#top
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a/b.html?c=1&amp;d=2#top">https://x.org/a/b.html?c=1&amp;d=2#top</a></p>
~~ case: underscores and stars inside it are not emphasis
https://x.org/snake_case_name/a*b*c
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/snake_case_name/a*b*c">https://x.org/snake_case_name/a*b*c</a></p>
~~ case: two in a line
https://a.org and https://b.org
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://a.org">https://a.org</a> and <a href="https://b.org">https://b.org</a></p>
~~ case: at the start of a paragraph's second line
first line
https://x.org/two
~~ want
<p id="p1">first line
<a href="https://x.org/two">https://x.org/two</a></p>
~~ case: after an equals sign
url=https://x.org
~~ want
<p id="p1">url=<a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></p>
~~ case: letters past ASCII in its path
https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/日本語 here
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/日本語">https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/日本語</a> here</p>
~~ case: in strong
**https://x.org**
~~ want
<p id="p1"><strong><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></strong></p>
~~ case: in emphasis, an underscore inside
*https://x.org/a_b*
~~ want
<p id="p1"><em><a href="https://x.org/a_b">https://x.org/a_b</a></em></p>
~~ case: in underscore emphasis
_https://x.org/a_b_
~~ want
<p id="p1"><em><a href="https://x.org/a_b">https://x.org/a_b</a></em></p>
~~ case: in a list item
- https://x.org
~~ want
<ul>
<li><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></li>
</ul>
~~ case: in a heading
## See https://x.org
~~ want
<h2 id="see-httpsxorg">See <a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></h2>
~~ case: in a table cell
| a |
|---|
| https://x.org |
~~ want
<div class="table-wrap"><table>
<thead><tr><th>a</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
~~ case: in a quote
> https://x.org
~~ want
<blockquote>
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a></p>
</blockquote>
~~ case: beside a markdown link
[a](https://a.org) and https://b.org
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://a.org">a</a> and <a href="https://b.org">https://b.org</a></p>
